new_owner_policy.creator: UnifiedExecProcessManager::terminate_process
new_owner_policy.scope: one termination request and the existing same-owner native-exit observation
new_owner_policy.provenance: explicit root task decision; newly introduced product policy, not measured behavior or a preexisting guarantee
outside_budget: preexisting manager store-lock acquisition and post-confirmation unregister/cleanup
preemption of synchronous Local driver locks or OS kill calls

behavior: Original already-exited entry and its existing observe_current_exit implementation are unchanged. This patch does not expand that legacy raw-getter boundary.

Prior observation failure is captured before a single cleanup request. Cleanup occurs in this call under the shared deadline instead of a separate spawned request. Its result never replaces the prior first failure.

Original driver error precedence is preserved. A request error or request deadline returns ProcessFailed without being converted into success by a concurrent event; existing native observation remains retained.

A successful request is followed by a bounded wait on the original watch ProcessState. borrow_and_update snapshots and changed notifications avoid a lost wake, and no extra RPC or periodic sleep is introduced.

New observation confirmation uses only the watch-native result, never separate Local has_exited and exit_code getters. A retained actual exit keeps its original code, including legitimate observed exited-without-code.

If the shared deadline expires after a successful request, the final decision runs inside state_tx.send_modify. A retained has_exited succeeds; otherwise observation_failed preserves the first failure and the operation remains indeterminate.

Manager still releases its store lock before awaiting, returns false without removing an unconfirmed owner, and performs the original Arc::ptr_eq and initial_exec_command_active checks before successful removal.
No new terminal state is inferred from ACK, Closed, output EOF, write refusal, an elapsed deadline or cancellation.

cancellation_boundary.at_most_once_definition: At most one request per terminate_confirmed invocation; original terminate and Drop cleanup semantics are unchanged outside this entry.
cancellation_boundary.remote: The request future can be dropped at its deadline. This does not retract an already sent termination or replay it. Existing RpcClient call slots are RAII-held; dropping response_rx closes it, next admission prunes closed pending entries, and late replies remove their own request id. The independent native event observer remains live and can retain later real exits.
cancellation_boundary.local: The original synchronous Local terminate driver is invoked inline. Its return is followed immediately by a deadline check; the budget does not claim to interrupt a blocked synchronous implementation.
cancellation_boundary.scope: No Arc/Box ownership, transport retry, RPC codec, ProcessState schema, PTY driver or cleanup-custody changes.

regressions.name: successful_ack_waits_for_a_later_native_exit
regressions.purpose: Two explicit polls bracket the released ACK before an Exited event is published. ACK-only must remain Pending; later same-owner code 61 succeeds with one request.

regressions.name: termination_waits_for_the_drivers_later_native_result
regressions.purpose: Local driver terminator increments once while its native-result sender is retained; confirmation must remain Pending until actual code 53 arrives.

regressions.name: termination_request_deadline_keeps_the_native_observer_alive
regressions.purpose: The original remote request never ACKs within the budget; caller receives request-deadline error with no fabricated exit. Later actual code 67 is retained by the still-live observer, with no repeated request.

regressions.name: termination_without_a_native_driver_result_remains_indeterminate
regressions.purpose: Successful Local request without native result expires indeterminate; code 59 delivered afterward is still retained along with the original failure.

regressions.name: retained_observation_failure_wins_when_cleanup_exceeds_its_deadline
regressions.purpose: A prior Failed event remains the returned and retained first failure even when its one cleanup request itself times out.

regressions.name: unconfirmed_termination_retains_the_same_process_owner
regressions.purpose: Exercise the real manager-created one-second policy with an ACK-only process; result is false and the same Arc remains registered.
